3c2a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores destination in $F2/$F3 and source in $F0/$F1.

3c3d.name: RLE-STRIDE!
3c3d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the low byte of its argument in $F6.

3c4b.name: BANK-COPY-LENGTH
3c4b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: 16-bit count read by $3C9C: high byte supplies full 256-byte pages and low byte a final partial page.

3c54.name: BANK-COPY-SOURCE
3c54.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $DD, the source pointer used by native $3C83.

3c5d.name: BANK-COPY-DEST
3c5d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $DF, the destination pointer used by native $3C83.

3c67.name: ENTER-RAM-UNDER-OS
3c67.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for VCOUNT bit7 to transition, synchronizes WSYNC, disables IRQs and decrements PORTB to expose RAM beneath the OS ROM. Native subroutine returns with RTS.
3c67.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3c83.name: COPY-BANK-PAGE
3c83.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: After exposing RAM under the OS, copies Y bytes backward through pointers $DD/$DF, restores PORTB and IRQs, and RTS. Y=0 copies a full 256-byte page.
3c83.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3c9c.name: COPY-BANK-BYTES
3c9c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the full pages and remainder specified by $3C4B through native $3C83, preserving the Forth parameter-stack X register.

3ccb.name: COPY-UNDER-OS
3ccb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores length and both bank-copy pointers, then executes $3C9C. Tutorial PMOVE has the same parameter roles, but this game uses its own raster-synchronized implementation.

3ce3.name: BANK-FIRST-SPAN
3ce3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $2800 is the size of logical offsets mapped to physical $D800..$FFFF; later offsets map from $C000.

3ced.name: SPLIT-BANK-RANGE
3ced.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Splits a logical offset/count pair at $2800 into physical copy spans, mapping lower offsets from $D800 and higher offsets from $C000. Called by both directions of bank transfer.
3ced.stack_effect: offset count -- address1 count1 address2 count2 count1

3d74.name: STORE-BANK-RANGE
3d74.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses $3CED to split the logical range, then copies from normal RAM into one or two physical RAM-under-OS spans with $3CCB.

3d97.name: FETCH-BANK-RANGE
3d97.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses $3CED to split the logical range, then copies one or two RAM-under-OS spans into contiguous normal RAM with $3CCB.

3db9.name: SPLIT-UNSIGNED-BYTES
3db9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native code moves the original high byte to a new zero-extended stack cell and clears both high halves.

3dd2.name: PATCH-VBI-SLOT
3dd2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Parses a Forth name with -FIND, writes JSR opcode $20 at table+1+3*slot and stores the target native entry after it; otherwise prints ERROR VBI.

3e15.name: VBI-CALL-TABLE
3e15.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Mutable slots of three-byte native calls/NOPs, ending in a jump to $3E53. RUN-VBI1 installs execution at table+1 via SETVBV.

3e41.name: VBI-SLOT!
3e41.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Supplies the VBI call table to $3DD2; the parsed name determines the installed JSR target.

3e51.name: RETURN-FROM-VBI
3e51.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native JMP $E462 invokes the OS XITVBV exit; not a normal Forth NEXT return.
3e51.calling_convention: Assembly VBI exit; jumps to OS XITVBV.

3e60.name: RUN-VBI1
3e60.evidence: Matches GAM FORTH deferred-VBI native routine: SETVBV with X/Y selecting vector $3E18.

3e7d.name: STOP-VBI1
3e7d.evidence: Matches GAM FORTH deferred-VBI native routine: SETVBV with X/Y selecting vector $E462.

3e96.name: RECORD-SPAN
3e96.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell used by resource scanning as the current u16 record length plus two; native PM graphics copies also reuse it as plane byte count.

3ea0.name: RECORD-WRAP-HIGH
3ea0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native scan $3ECB compares pointer high byte against this threshold, initially $A7, then sets it to $D8 after wrapping the resource window.

3ea9.name: RECORD-POINTER
3ea9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $D2, the current pointer used by resource scanning and PM-plane copies.

3eb3.name: ADVANCE-RECORD-POINTER
3eb3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds the 16-bit RECORD-SPAN cell to $D2/$D3 and returns with RTS.
3eb3.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3ecb.name: SCAN-LENGTH-RECORDS
3ecb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks the requested number of u16-length records, advancing by length+2 and handling the resource-window wrap. Called by both visible-RAM and banked-resource lookup.

3f0e.name: SET-RECORD-SCAN-POINTER
3f0e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the top Forth cell into $D2/$D3 and saves X in XSAVE; native helper returns RTS without dropping parameters.
3f0e.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

3f21.name: SCAN-RAM-RECORD
3f21.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets the wrap threshold to $A7, initializes $D2/$D3, scans records, and drops both arguments; resulting address remains in RECORD-POINTER.

3f3b.name: LENGTH-RECORD-TABLE:
3f3b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Defining word stores a u16 total length and allocates bytes. Its DOES> tail skips that length and indexes variable-length records through $3F21, returning the record header address.

3f58.name: WORD-COUNT
3f58.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns address+2 and the 16-bit length stored at address.

3f6d.name: LENGTH-RECORD-ADDR
3f6d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Runs $3F21 and fetches its resulting $D2/$D3 pointer. The result points at the u16 length field.

3f7f.name: STORE-QUOTED-RECORD
3f7f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Parses text delimited by a double quote, copies the characters after the record's u16 header, then stores the text length in that header.

3fa6.name: RECORD-OFFSET
3fa6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves base, scans indexed record, and subtracts base from the resulting pointer.

3fbe.name: BANKED-TRANSFER
3fbe.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Nonzero selects sector transfer through PAD and the logical bank-copy helpers; zero transfers directly through normal RAM. Set by $5CED when loading banked scene assets.

3fd5.name: TRANSFER-BANK-OFFSET
3fd5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Logical bank offset advanced by B/BUF during the PAD-staged disk transfer.

3fdf.name: PREPARE-SECTOR-BUFFER
3fdf.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: In normal mode leaves all three transfer arguments unchanged. In banked mode replaces the address with PAD after fetching a sector from the supplied logical bank offset; retains first/count.
3fdf.stack_effect: address first count -- buffer first count

4006.name: ADVANCE-SECTOR-BUFFER
4006.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For normal RAM adds B/BUF; in banked mode keeps PAD, updates the logical offset and copies a sector between PAD and banked RAM according to S-L.

404d.name: DIRECTORY-BUFFER
404d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Points at the PAD+B/BUF sector buffer loaded from DIRB by $4062.

4057.name: GROUP-END-SECTOR
4057.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Set to start sector plus sector count while $4062 resolves a directory entry.

44f1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores maximum counted-line length plus four, with a seven-column special case for a single-line message.

44fb.name: MEASURE-MESSAGE
44fb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks a line-count byte followed by counted strings, computes maximum width+4, stores width fields and uses width seven when there is only one line.

4564.name: NEXT-TEXT-ROW
4564.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Increments the OS text row through Y@ and Y!.

4574.name: PRINT-CENTERED-LINES
4574.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks the counted-line message, sets each starting column to 20-length/2, prints via STYPE, and advances the row.

45a4.name: SHOW-MESSAGE
45a4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For a nonempty counted-line group, clears following text rows, measures and draws its frame, prints centered lines, and restores the original row.

45f5.name: DISK-ERROR-MESSAGES
45f5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: u16-length vector of Polish tape/disk prompts, including PODAJ STAN LICZNIKA and error/insertion messages; consumed by $468C after transfer failures.

468c.name: SHOW-DISK-ERROR
468c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes the disk-error vector, skips its u16 header and displays the multiline message.

469b.name: CLEAR-TEXT-AREA
469b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Erases $1B8 bytes from SAVMSC and resets text position to 0,0.

46b6.name: TRANSFER-IS-LOAD
46b6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects $4221 load when nonzero or $423B save when zero in $46C0.

46c0.name: TRY-GROUP-TRANSFER
46c0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Keeps transfer arguments, clears text, pauses the DLI, tries load/save, resumes DLI, and displays/acknowledges an error if needed.

46fe.name: RETRY-GROUP-TRANSFER
46fe.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeats $46C0 until the stored transfer error is zero, then drops the retained transfer arguments.

4718.name: READ-RESOURCE-GROUP
4718.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets transfer mode to read and invokes the retrying transfer.

472a.name: WRITE-RESOURCE-GROUP
472a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets transfer mode to write and invokes the retrying transfer.

473c.name: READ-BANK-RECORD-LENGTH
473c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native helper reads the u16 at ($D2),Y into RECORD-SPAN; returns RTS. Used while OS ROM is switched out.

4751.name: SCAN-BANK-RECORD
4751.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets banked scanning threshold, exposes RAM under OS, scans to the indexed record, reads its length, restores PORTB/IRQs and drops both arguments.

4771.name: BANK-RECORD-RANGE

47a4.name: NESTED-BANK-RECORD

47bd.name: BANK-RESOURCE-RANGE
47bd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses banked base $D800 and returns the indexed resource's payload offset and length.

47cd.name: RESOURCE-BASE
47cd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Startup selects $A050 for introduction resources and $A3E0 for gameplay resources.

47d7.name: RESOURCE-BASE@

47e5.name: PICTURE-STAGING-BASE
47e5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pointer cell initially $A392; its fetched address receives decoded object pictures before composition.

47ef.name: PICTURE-STAGING@
47ef.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches PICTURE-STAGING-BASE; $58F1 decodes item art here and $54AB composites it into the scene picture.

47fe.name: RESOURCE-ADDR
47fe.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes a u16-length record at RESOURCE-BASE through $3F6D; returns its length header.

480c.name: FETCH-RESOURCE-TO
480c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a banked resource payload and copies it to the supplied normal-RAM destination.

481d.name: FETCH-NESTED-RESOURCE
481d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a nested banked resource and copies its payload to the supplied destination.

4830.name: FETCH-RESOURCE
4830.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the chosen banked resource into the visible RESOURCE-BASE buffer.

483d.name: WAIT-RASTER-HALF
483d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native loop waits for VCOUNT bit7 to clear and then set; returns RTS. Used to synchronize player positions and graphics work.

484f.name: WAIT-RASTER
484f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls the native raster wait at $483F and returns to Forth NEXT.

485e.name: BITMAP-BASE

4aa0.name: TRANSITION-PARAMETERS!

4c8a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stored by $4CD2 as picture x minus the supplied destination origin; used by $4CB9 for composition placement.

4c93.name: PICTURE-Y-OFFSET
4c93.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stored by $4CD2 as picture y minus the supplied destination origin; used by $4CB9 and hit-map placement.

4c9c.name: EXPAND-PICTURE-DATA
4c9c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads width/height from the source, advances past its two-byte dimensions, sets RLE parameters and expands into destination with the requested stride.

4cb9.name: PICTURE-OFFSET
4cb9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds PICTURE-X-OFFSET and stride*PICTURE-Y-OFFSET to the supplied base.

4cd2.name: SET-PICTURE-OFFSETS
4cd2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads picture x/y and subtracts supplied origin coordinates, storing relative x/y offsets.

4cf6.name: OVERLAY-PACKED-PICTURE
4cf6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses both four-byte picture headers to compute relative placement, then expands source RLE bytes into destination at its own row stride.

4d22.name: DRAW-RESOURCE-PICTURE
4d22.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves the picture record, sets origin-relative offsets using x=4/y=0, then decodes the image into BITMAP-BASE at its stored x/y with stride40.

4d53.name: DECODE-PICTURE
4d53.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the source's x/y/width/height header to destination, then expands its packed payload there.

4d6d.name: DECODE-SCENE-RESOURCE
4d6d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a picture resource and decodes it into the $0600 scene picture buffer.

4d7f.name: OVERLAY-SCENE-RESOURCE
4d7f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a packed picture and overlays it into the existing $0600 scene picture buffer.

4d90.name: HIT-MAP-SELECTOR
4d90.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Zero chooses the base hit map; nonzero selects the zoom hit map at +$284. Scene/zoom drawing routines set it explicitly.

4d99.name: HIT-MAP-BASE
4d99.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $A058 addresses the base room hit map, whose first two bytes are width/height.

4da3.name: HIT-MAP@
4da3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns $A058, adding $284 when HIT-MAP-SELECTOR is nonzero.

4dbd.name: PLAYER-COLORS
4dbd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Bytes copied to OS PCOLR0..3 at $02C0 by $4DCC to color the player/missile cursor.

4dcc.name: SET-PLAYER-COLORS
4dcc.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies four bytes from PLAYER-COLORS to OS color shadows $02C0..$02C3.

4de2.name: PM-BASE
4de2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell stores the player/missile memory base in bytes; set while writing PMBASE hardware $D407.

4ded.name: PLAYER-DATA-BASE
4ded.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns PM-BASE+$400, the first player area for the configured single-line PM graphics.

4e02.name: PM-BASE!
4e02.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes the page number to ANTIC PMBASE $D407 and stores page*256 in PM-BASE.

4e1f.name: CLEAR-PLAYERS
4e1f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Erases $2FF bytes from PM-BASE+$400, covering the cursor's three player planes.

4e33.name: ENABLE-PLAYERS
4e33.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes three to GTIA GRACTL $D01D, enabling missile and player DMA display.

4e48.name: DISABLE-PLAYERS
4e48.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears eight horizontal position registers at $D000 and writes zero to GRACTL.

4e72.name: SET-CURSOR-PM-X
4e72.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for the raster point, then writes the supplied x to HPOSP0, HPOSP1 and HPOSP2 and drops it.

4e8b.name: CURSOR-PLAYER-BITMAP
4e8b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Body at $4E8D contains three 13-byte cursor planes. $4F0F refers to that literal body address; its saved DOCOL field is not evidence this data is executable Forth.
4e8b.calling_convention: Data body referenced by literal address; do not execute its saved DOCOL entry.

4ebb.name: PM-COPY-DEST
4ebb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $D4, the destination pointer used by the native player-plane copy.

4ec6.name: PM-COPY-PLANES
4ec6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native $4EE5 uses its low byte as plane count and advances destination by256 for each plane.

4ed3.name: PM-COPY-PARAMETERS!
4ed3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores plane count and the per-plane byte count (the shared RECORD-SPAN cell).

4ee5.name: COPY-PM-PLANES
4ee5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for raster, copies each plane from $D2 to $D4, advances source by plane length and destination by256, preserving Forth X.

4f0f.name: SET-CURSOR-PM-Y
4f0f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies the fixed three-plane,13-row cursor bitmap to PM-BASE+$400+y using $4EE5.

4f3d.name: CONTEXT-BYTE-ARRAY:
4f3d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Defining word stores an index-cell address and allocates bytes; DOES> fetches that index and adds it to the payload address.

4f59.name: CURSOR-AXIS
4f59.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Zero selects horizontal cursor cells; one selects the adjacent vertical cells in the four context-indexed arrays.

4f64.name: CURSOR-ORIGIN
4f64.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Axis-indexed byte origins used with grid step and position to compute PM screen coordinates.

4f73.name: CURSOR-GRID-POS
4f73.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Axis-indexed cursor x/y grid positions; input wait returns both bytes and navigation saves/restores their pair.

4f82.name: CURSOR-GRID-STEP
4f82.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Axis-indexed pixel steps, normally x4 and y6; $4FAA scales the selected grid position by this value.

4f91.name: CURSOR-GRID-LIMIT
4f91.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Axis-indexed maximum grid coordinates; movement stops at zero or this limit.

4f9f.name: CURSOR-MOVE-DELTA
4f9f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the signed one-step input delta during animated cursor movement.

4faa.name: CURSOR-PIXEL
4faa.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Computes selected-axis origin + grid-position*grid-step.

4fc5.name: STEP-CURSOR
4fc5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For nonzero signed movement, checks the selected-axis limit, animates PM position across one grid step and adjusts its stored grid byte. Intended deltas are -1,0,+1.

503d.name: TRIGGER@
503d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads GTIA trigger register $D010 plus controller index and masks bit zero.

5052.evidence: Candidate name; structural sequence match, not an independently verified semantic match. Corresponding AD2044 CFA $4F47 (-1) in contiguous 3-definition sequence matching header flags, name suffix, word kind and body size. GAM FORTH 11_A_Graf.ATR CFA $9612, identical body after known address relocation; surviving name length and suffix match

505c.name: STICK-X-DELTA-TABLE
505c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Threaded selector indexed by raw STICK nibble minus five; entries yield +1,-1 or0 for horizontal movement.

507e.name: STICK-Y-DELTA-TABLE
507e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Companion selector yields vertical -1/0/+1 after the raw joystick nibble is reduced by five.

50a3.name: JOYSTICK-DELTA
50a3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads OS STICK0+controller at $0278, subtracts five and applies the X/Y selector tables. Unlike AD2044's raw-nibble helper, this word accepts a controller index.

50c3.name: INIT-CURSOR-PLAYERS
50c3.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets SDMCTL=$3E and GPRIOR=1, selects PM base $A000, clears players, installs their colors and enables GRACTL.

50ed.name: CURSOR-ORIGIN!
50ed.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets vertical origin y+$21 and horizontal origin 4*x+$32 in the axis-indexed cursor array.

511b.name: CURSOR-LIMITS!
511b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores rows-1 and columns-1 as vertical/horizontal maximum grid positions.

513e.name: CURSOR-STEPS!
513e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the horizontal and vertical byte steps used to animate cursor movement.

5157.name: VIEW-STACK
5157.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Counted stack of 16-bit view IDs; the first byte counts stored bytes. $516E pushes and $519B pops.

516e.name: PUSH-VIEW
516e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the cell at VIEW-STACK+count+2, then increments the byte count by two. This implementation has no capacity check.

5188.name: P
5188.evidence: Intact dictionary name in supplied Klatwa v1 image.

519b.name: POP-VIEW
519b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches the cell at VIEW-STACK+count, then decrements a nonzero byte count by two; zero count returns the initial cell.

51c1.name: CELL-ARRAY:
51c1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Defining word allocates twice the requested count; DOES> doubles the index and adds it to the payload.

51dd.name: VIEW-CURSOR-POSITIONS
51dd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array stores one cursor x/y byte pair for each view-stack byte-count index, as used by $51F5/$5211.

51f5.name: RESTORE-VIEW-CURSOR
51f5.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes saved cursor cells by current VIEW-STACK byte count, fetches the packed pair and writes it to the horizontal/vertical cursor bytes.

5211.name: SAVE-VIEW-CURSOR
5211.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the current packed cursor position at the cell-array index given by the current VIEW-STACK byte count.

522d.name: CENTER-VIEW-CURSOR
522d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses active hit-map dimensions: y becomes height/2 and x becomes width/2-1.

5257.name: CONFIGURE-VIEW-CURSOR
5257.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses picture origin for a zoom view or x4/y0 for the base view, applies active hit-map dimensions as limits and fixes cursor steps to4/6 pixels.

5289.name: HIT-MAP-CELL
5289.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns the hit-map byte at base+2+x+y*width for the currently selected map.

52a4.name: HIT-MAP-OFFSET
52a4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds horizontal picture offset and stride*(vertical offset/6), matching six bitmap rows per hit-map row.

52c2.name: EXPAND-HIT-MAP
52c2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Decodes a packed width/height hit-map record at its relative picture offset into the active hit-map buffer.

52de.name: LOAD-BASE-HIT-MAP
52de.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the base map, copies its dimensions (doubling width), configures/centers the cursor and expands the packed map.

530a.name: LOAD-ZOOM-HIT-MAP
530a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the zoom map, copies its width/height header and expands its packed payload.

5328.name: OVERLAY-HIT-MAP
5328.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Resolves a mask resource and expands it into the current hit map using the current picture offsets.

5338.name: BLIT-HIT-THRESHOLD
5338.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native blend compares this byte against the hit-map byte at ($D2),Y when BLIT-IGNORE-HIT is zero.

5343.name: BLIT-IGNORE-HIT
5343.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When nonzero, native blend skips the threshold comparison against ($D2),Y; zero enables that test and six-row mask-pointer progression.

534c.name: MASK-PICTURE-BYTE
534c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native helper processes four two-bit pixels, combines a source-pixel mask with destination, and tracks runs through $FC. Returns masked byte in $FA with RTS.
534c.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

538a.name: BLIT-MASKED
538a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Zero makes $5393 copy source directly; nonzero enables masked blending with the optional hit/depth comparison.

5393.name: BLEND-PICTURE-BYTE
5393.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies or masks a pixel byte from ($F2),Y into ($F0),Y according to $538A/$5343 and the hit-map threshold. Native helper returns RTS.
5393.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

53be.name: BLEND-PICTURE-ROW
53be.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls the byte blending helper for Y=0 through width-1, width held in $F7. Native RTS helper.
53be.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

53d1.name: BLIT-ROW-POSITION
53d1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Row counter incremented by native $53E4 when clipping is enabled; output terminates when it passes $70.

53da.name: BLIT-NO-ROW-CLIP
53da.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Nonzero bypasses row counter/clipping in $53E4; zero enables clipping at row112.

53e4.name: BLEND-PICTURE-ROWS
53e4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Processes the rectangle row by row, advances source/destination pointers by independent strides, steps the hit-map pointer every six rows when enabled, and optionally clips at row112. Returns RTS.
53e4.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

543b.name: BLIT-PICTURE
543b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves the Forth stack register while invoking the native rectangle compositor at $53E6.

544c.name: PICTURE-SCREEN-ADDR
544c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads picture x/y and returns BITMAP-BASE+x+40*y.

5468.name: BLIT-PARAMETERS
5468.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores destination stride, source pointer and width/height/source stride, then calls the native blitter. Header begins with width/height.

548f.name: DRAW-DECODED-PICTURE
548f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Converts the picture's x/y header into its screen address, sets destination pointer and blits width/height pixels with40-byte screen stride.

54ab.name: COMPOSE-STAGED-PICTURE
54ab.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses staged picture and $0600 scene headers to calculate relative offsets, then blits the staged image into the scene buffer using scene width as destination stride.

54dd.name: SCENE-BACKUP-PICTURE
54dd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $0A00 is a four-byte picture header followed by a saved screen rectangle used when entering/leaving zoom views.

54e6.name: SCENE-BACKUP-BYTES
54e6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $0B90 is the normal-RAM staging location for $112 bytes copied to/from logical bank offset $36EA by zoom backup routines.

54f1.name: SAVE-SCENE-BACKGROUND
54f1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies current backup bytes to bank offset $36EA, saves the scene picture header and captures its screen rectangle into the $0A00 backup using the blitter.

5548.name: ITEM-RESOURCE-BASE
5548.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $9932 is the normal-RAM base of the item-art u16-length resource collection.

5552.name: ITEM-RESOURCE-ADDR
5552.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes the item-art length-record collection at $9932.

5560.name: SAVED-STATE-BASE
5560.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Start of the saved game-state span copied by $78E8/$7978/$79C5; contains initial cells2 and10 before CURRENT-ROOM and the spellbook records. No more specific direct reader was found.

556d.name: CURRENT-ROOM
556d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Room cell set by $5A49 and read by room/view list selection, achievements and high-level game actions.

5577.name: SPELLBOOK-RECORDS
5577.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: u16-length vector holding spellbook entries; $60B5 renders KSIEGA CZAROW and $6256 interprets spell/ingredient fields.

5638.name: ITEM-POSITIONS
5638.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array of x/y byte pairs. $58F1 indexes by objectID-$CA and installs the coordinates before drawing a dropped item.

566e.name: PART2-ITEM-POSITIONS
566e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initial x/y coordinate table copied into ITEM-POSITIONS during the part-two setup at $79E3.

5691.name: CURRENT-PART-GROUP
5691.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects the game-part resource group. Start/load paths set2 or4; saved-game loading derives group4 or6 by adding two.

56ae.name: ROOM-OBJECT-STATE
56ae.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Mutable nested u16-length records indexed by room and view in $5A35; entries are the object IDs composed when drawing each scene/view.

587c.name: ROOM-ACHIEVEMENT-BITS
587c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original:31-byte room-indexed achievement bitmap. $69E8 ORs a mask into the current room byte and $69C0 counts set bits toward a65-achievement score.

58a4.name: PUZZLE-STATE-CELLS
58a4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell array used by spell/puzzle actions: flags include magic disabled, gates, ending and multi-item puzzles. Its values are part of the saved state.

58cf.name: LAST-DIRECTION
58cf.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Updated by movement at $7423 and preserved in the saved state by $78E8/$7978; records the previous movement direction.

58d9.name: ITEM-PICTURE-INDEX
58d9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Maps an inventory/drop object ID to its picture resource: 2*(object-$CA)+2, followed by its paired mask resource.

58f1.name: COMPOSE-DROPPED-ITEM
58f1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Enables masked blending, decodes item art, applies the saved ITEM-POSITIONS coordinates, composes it into the scene and expands its paired hit map, then disables masked blending.

5937.name: DRAW-BASE-PICTURE
5937.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the selected picture directly to screen and loads the next resource as its base hit map.

5949.name: DRAW-PICTURE-AND-MASK
5949.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the picture; only if the word after its length-bounded payload is nonzero does it expand the next resource as a hit-map overlay.

596f.name: DECODE-ZOOM-PICTURE
596f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Decodes a picture into the scene buffer and loads the following resource as the zoom hit map.

5981.name: COMPOSE-PICTURE-AND-MASK
5981.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Overlays a picture in the scene buffer, then expands its following mask resource into the selected hit map.

5993.name: ROOM-RECORD-BUFFER
5993.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $9752 receives a room's nested descriptor record before its background and object resources are selected.

599c.name: SPLIT-OBJECT-ID
599c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Divides by100, doubles the quotient for the resource collection number and retains the remainder as the local object index.

59b1.name: CLASSIFY-OBJECT
59b1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: IDs0/1 produce only0; IDs above200 retain the original ID and return1 (item art); IDs2..200 load the collection selected by ID/100 and return local index followed by class2 (scene art). Stack arity therefore differs for ignored IDs.

59e4.name: DRAW-OBJECT-LIST
59e4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks object bytes in a u16-length record beginning at start; classifies each ID and draws its picture/mask when nonzero.

5a0d.name: DRAW-ROOM-BACKGROUND
5a0d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches room-1 from nested collection1 into ROOM-RECORD-BUFFER, loads its specified resource group, draws base picture0 and remaining static object entries.

5a35.name: ROOM-VIEW-OBJECTS
5a35.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes outer ROOM-OBJECT-STATE by room, skips its u16 header, then indexes the selected view's u16-length object list.

5a49.name: DRAW-ROOM
5a49.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores CURRENT-ROOM, draws its static background, then draws the mutable object list for base view0.

5a65.name: EXPAND-THREE-BYTE-ROW
5a65.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native helper expands a three-byte template across a wider destination row: first and last bytes are borders, middle byte repeats. Returns RTS.
5a65.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5a92.name: ADVANCE-EXPANDED-ROW
5a92.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds destination width $F7 to $F0/$F1 through the RLE source-pointer increment helper; native RTS.
5a92.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5aa0.name: ADVANCE-ROW-TEMPLATE
5aa0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds three to template pointer $F2/$F3; native RTS.
5aa0.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5ab4.name: EXPAND-SIX-ROWS
5ab4.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeats the three-byte row expansion six times, decrementing remaining height and advancing both pointers; native RTS.
5ab4.calling_convention: Assembly subroutine entry; returns with RTS.

5acd.name: EXPAND-PICTURE-FRAME
5acd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Expands the first six template rows, repeats the middle six-row strip, then adds a final strip; used to frame zoom pictures.

5af1.name: PREPARE-ZOOM-FRAME
5af1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches an object's four-byte geometry, enlarges it by two columns and12 rows, clears/configures the zoom hit map, then expands a repeated border around the scene picture.

5b89.name: COMPOSE-OBJECT-LIST
5b89.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Walks the byte list range; item-class IDs use dropped-item composition and scene-class IDs use picture/mask composition.

5bba.name: COMPOSE-VIEW
5bba.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Gets the current room's view list, prepares its first object's zoom frame, then composes every listed object into it.

5bd9.name: RESTORE-SCENE-BACKGROUND
5bd9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the saved $0A00 background picture and fetches $112 saved bytes from logical bank offset $36EA back to $0B90.

5bf2.name: PUSH-AND-DRAW-VIEW
5bf2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Composes the view, saves the base background when entering the first zoom, pushes its ID, draws its picture and configures its cursor.

5c15.name: ENTER-VIEW
5c15.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves current cursor position, invokes $5BF2 and centers the new view cursor.

5c26.name: REDRAW-CURRENT-VIEW
5c26.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches top view ID through P, recomposes it and draws the scene picture.

5c39.name: LEAVE-VIEW
5c39.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pops/discards the current view; redraws the preceding zoom or restores the base background, then reconfigures/restores its cursor.

5c61.name: ENTER-INVENTORY-VIEW
5c61.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves any active zoom background/cursor, pushes view1 and composes its special room0/view1 object list before drawing and configuring the cursor.

5c9f.name: LEAVE-INVENTORY-VIEW
5c9f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Pops inventory view, restores base background, then rebuilds the preceding nested views and restores saved cursor coordinates.

5ce1.name: LOAD-ITEM-ART-ENABLED
5ce1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When nonzero, $5CED loads the following resource group into ITEM-RESOURCE-BASE after the main banked group succeeds.

5ced.name: LOAD-PART-RESOURCES
5ced.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loads up to120 sectors into logical bank offset0; if LOAD-ITEM-ART-ENABLED is nonzero, also loads24 sectors of the next group into item-art RAM. Retries the sequence on disk failure.

5d47.name: NIC
5d47.evidence: Candidate name; structural sequence match, not an independently verified semantic match. Corresponding AD2044 CFA $7146 (NIC) in contiguous 3-definition sequence matching header flags, name suffix, word kind and body size. GAM FORTH 42_A_GrafDos.ATR CFA $A4BE, identical body after known address relocation; surviving name length and suffix match

5d51.name: KEYBOARD-SELECTION
5d51.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Input wait stores the one-based key-list match here. A nonzero value also ends the wait even if the trigger is not pressed.

5d5b.name: KEYBOARD-SHORTCUTS-ENABLED
5d5b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Multiplier applied to the raw key-list match in input wait; zero suppresses keyboard selection.

5d64.name: BASE-VIEW-KEYS-ENABLED
5d64.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Together with an empty view stack, gates whether input wait interprets the shortcut key list; high-level modal screens change this flag.

5d6d.name: WAIT-TRIGGER-RELEASE
5d6d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeatedly samples active-low controller0 trigger with five-frame pauses until released.

5d84.name: SHORTCUT-KEYCODES
5d84.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Three bytes at body address $5D86 are raw CH keycodes21,05,28; input wait searches them directly. The saved DOCOL field is not executed.
5d84.calling_convention: Data body referenced by literal address; do not execute its saved DOCOL entry.

5d92.name: WAIT-GAME-INPUT
5d92.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears CH, initializes cursor players, waits for trigger release, applies controller0 movements and shortcut keys until trigger/key selection, then returns the grid x/y bytes and disables players.

5e3e.name: DEFAULT-GAME-COLORS
5e3e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initial color bytes copied into GAME-COLOR-TABLE by $5E7E, with the seventh byte used for COLPF3 shadow.

5e4f.name: INSTALL-GAME-COLORS
5e4f.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Points the DLI at GAME-COLOR-TABLE, enables two display-list interrupt bits, installs the handler and writes COLPF3 shadow.

5e7e.name: RESET-GAME-COLORS
5e7e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies seven default color bytes to the live table and installs the game's color DLI.

5e93.name: TITLE-MUSIC-OR-SPRITES
